description: Search the catalogue of node types a workflow can use: triggers (webhook, schedule, email, agent tool), logic (if, switch, loop, wait, code) and integrations with third-party services. Returns each type's id, display name, description, category and group, without property schemas to keep it small. Filter with `name`, then call get_node_schemas for the exact types you will use. Needs no account data.

name.description: Case-insensitive substring matched against the type id and display name, e.g. 'slack'.

name: list_node_types
title: List node types
